Tax uses **ROUND_HALF_EVEN** (banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). The finance team decided this in March 2026, and the project notes say not to use ROUND_HALF_UP.

That decision is recorded only in the project's memory notes (`.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_*.md`). The code doesn't implement it yet. `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py:11` just raises `NotImplementedError`, and nothing else in the repo sets a rounding mode. When you implement it, quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
